# Setup
```{r}
#install.packages(c("survey", "mgcv", "glmnet", "dplyr"))

library(survey)
library(mgcv)
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(pROC)
```

# Survey design
```{r}
df <- readRDS("../data/brfss2024_clean.rds")

# create survey design object
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

brfss_design <- svydesign(
  id = ~PSU,
  strata = ~STSTR,
  weights = ~WEIGHT,
  data = df,
  nest = TRUE
)
```

# Logistic Regression
## weighted
```{r}
weighted_glm <- svyglm(
  MEDCOST1 ~ region +
    rurality +
    sex +
    agegroup +
    race +
    income +
    maritalstatus +
    education +
    employment +
    healthstatus +
    physhlth_days +
    menthlth_days +
    depression +
    chronic_count +
    any_disability +
    insurance +
    pers_doc +
    last_checkup,
  design = brfss_design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)
summary(weighted_glm)
```

## Unweighted
```{r}
unweighted_glm <- glm(
  MEDCOST1 ~  . - PSU - STSTR - WEIGHT,
  data = df,
  family = binomial()
)
summary(unweighted_glm)
```

## Comparison
```{r}
# model summary comparison table
weighted_glm_summary <- summary(weighted_glm)$coefficients
unweighted_glm_summary <- summary(unweighted_glm)$coefficients

weighted_glm_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(weighted_glm_summary),
  Weighted_Estimate = weighted_glm_summary[, 1],
  Weighted_SE = weighted_glm_summary[, 2],
  Weighted_p = weighted_glm_summary[, 4]
)
unweighted_glm_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(unweighted_glm_summary),
  Unweighted_Estimate = unweighted_glm_summary[, 1],
  Unweighted_SE = unweighted_glm_summary[, 2],
  Unweighted_p = unweighted_glm_summary[, 4]
)

# OR and 95% CI
weighted_glm_df$Weighted_OR <- exp(weighted_glm_df$Weighted_Estimate)
weighted_ci <- exp(confint(weighted_glm))
weighted_glm_df$Weighted_OR_lower <- weighted_ci[, 1]
weighted_glm_df$Weighted_OR_upper <- weighted_ci[, 2]
unweighted_glm_df$Unweighted_OR <- exp(unweighted_glm_df$Unweighted_Estimate)
unweighted_ci <- exp(confint.default(unweighted_glm))
unweighted_glm_df$Unweighted_OR_lower <- unweighted_ci[, 1]
unweighted_glm_df$Unweighted_OR_upper <- unweighted_ci[, 2]

comparison_glm_table <- merge(
  weighted_glm_df,
  unweighted_glm_df,
  by = "Variable"
)

comparison_glm_table <- comparison_glm_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3))

comparison_glm_table
```

# Logistic regression (with Lasso)
```{r}
x <- model.matrix(
  MEDCOST1 ~ . - PSU - STSTR - WEIGHT,
  data = df
)[, -1]
y <- df$MEDCOST1
```

## Weighted
```{r}
weighted_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  x,
  y,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10,
  weights = df$WEIGHT
)
```

## Unweighted
```{r}
unweighted_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  x,
  y,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)
```

## Comparison
```{r}
# Lasso selected variables
lasso_out <- cbind(coef(weighted_lasso, s = "lambda.1se"),
                   coef(unweighted_lasso, s = "lambda.1se"))
colnames(lasso_out) <- c("Weighted", "Unweighted")
lasso_out

# Lasso plot
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(weighted_lasso$glmnet.fit, xvar = "lambda")
plot(weighted_lasso)
plot(unweighted_lasso$glmnet.fit, xvar = "lambda")
plot(unweighted_lasso)

# AUC comparison
weight_lasso_pred <- predict(weighted_lasso, newx = x, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")
unweighted_lasso_pred <- predict(unweighted_lasso, newx = x, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")
weighted_lasso_roc_obj <- roc(y, as.numeric(weighted_lasso_pred))
unweighted_lasso_roc_obj <- roc(y, as.numeric(unweighted_lasso_pred))
auc(weighted_lasso_roc_obj)
auc(unweighted_lasso_roc_obj)
```

# GAM
```{r}
df$survey_weight <- weights(brfss_design)
```

## Weighted
```{r}
weighted_gam <- gam(
  MEDCOST1 ~
    s(physhlth_days) +
    s(menthlth_days) +
    region +
    rurality +
    sex +
    agegroup +
    race +
    income +
    maritalstatus +
    education +
    employment +
    healthstatus +
    depression +
    chronic_count +
    any_disability +
    insurance +
    pers_doc +
    last_checkup,
  data = df,
  family = binomial(),
  weights = survey_weight
)

summary(weighted_gam)
```

## Unweighted
```{r}
unweighted_gam <- gam(
  MEDCOST1 ~
    s(physhlth_days) +
    s(menthlth_days) +
    region +
    rurality +
    sex +
    agegroup +
    race +
    income +
    maritalstatus +
    education +
    employment +
    healthstatus +
    depression +
    chronic_count +
    any_disability +
    insurance +
    pers_doc +
    last_checkup,
  data = df,
  family = binomial()
)

summary(unweighted_gam)
```

## Comparison
```{r}
# coefficients comparison table
weighted_gam_coef <- summary(weighted_gam)$p.coeff
unweighted_gam_coef <- summary(unweighted_gam)$p.coeff

gam_comparison <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(weighted_gam_coef),
  Weighted_Est = weighted_gam_coef,
  Unweighted_Est = unweighted_gam_coef,
  Weighted_OR = exp(weighted_gam_coef),
  Unweighted_OR = exp(unweighted_gam_coef)
)
gam_comparison

# smooth term plot 
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(weighted_gam, select = 1, main = "physhlth (weighted)")
plot(weighted_gam, select = 2, main = "menthlth (weighted)")
plot(unweighted_gam, select = 1, main = "physhlth (unweighted)")
plot(unweighted_gam, select = 2, main = "menthlth (unweighted)")

# AUC comparison
weighted_gam_pred <- predict(weighted_gam, type = "response")
unweighted_gam_pred <- predict(unweighted_gam, type = "response")
weighted_gam_roc_obj <- roc(y, as.numeric(weighted_gam_pred))
unweighted_gam_roc_obj <- roc(y, as.numeric(unweighted_gam_pred))
auc(weighted_gam_roc_obj)
auc(unweighted_gam_roc_obj)

# p-values for smooth terms
summary(weighted_gam)$s.pv
summary(unweighted_gam)$s.pv
```
